name: farsiui-calendar
description: Official Iranian public holidays and optional events for Jalali years. Date conversion is not included — consumers use a Jalali library (e.g. @internationalized/date).

license.note: Curated holiday rows for 1405 include national fixed Jalali days plus official religious/lunar holidays curated from Time.ir via pipe2time.ir (MIT). This is not a wholesale copy of any upstream repo. Non-holiday observances remain unpublished.

sources.description: Established fixed Jalali national public holidays (Nowruz period, 12 Farvardin, 13 Farvardin, 14–15 Khordad, 22 Bahman, 29 Esfand).

MIT Time.ir-derived JSON. For 1405, only events with isHoliday:true were curated into years/1405/holidays.json (titles cleaned; no wholesale import). weeks.json was not used (marks Fridays as holidays).
Time.ir HTML dumps used only for spot-checking suspicious dates. Not imported into FarsiUI JSON.
Per-day dumps with noise/duplicates and no clear license. Not used.

cdn.pinnedRefNote: For production, pin a git tag (e.g. calendar-1405.1.0) instead of @latest.

notes: Friday is a weekend day in Iran but is not listed as a holiday item; clients should treat weekends separately.
1405 Esfand has 29 days (non-leap in the algorithmic 33-year cycle used by @internationalized/date PersianCalendar).
Some Jalali dates carry two holiday items (e.g. 1405-01-01 Nowruz + Eid al-Fitr day 2; 1405-03-14 Khomeini demise + Eid al-Ghadir).
Schema is designed for FarsiUI calendar UI to import JSON statically or fetch via jsDelivr.
